chatMarkdownBlock.title: Chat Markdown
chatMarkdownBlock.description: Consistent AI response typography with code, tables, nested lists, tasks, footnotes and streaming.
chatMarkdownBlock.compositionBody: ChatMarkdownResponse composes ChatMessage, ChatMessageCopy and the shared Markdown component. Tables use Table bordered / md with 14px headers and body text via text-body / --font-size-body; fenced code uses CodeBlock highlighting, copy and wrapping. The host owns scrolling; author and actions accept existing message components.
chatMarkdownBlock.typographyBody: Body text uses text-body with its paired 14px font size and 20px line height and max-w-3xl reading width. H1 uses heading, H2 title, H3–H4 body, and H5–H6 label. Heading spacing is 16–32px; paragraphs use 12px; tables use text-body / --font-size-body (14px); tables, code and quotes use 16px; separators use 24px. Emphasis is semibold; inline code uses label-sized monospace on a raised surface. Numbered and nested lists retain their structure, tasks are read-only, images fit the column, and footnotes use instance-specific IDs. Colors and controls use existing semantic tokens.
chatMarkdownBlock.dataContractBody: Pass accumulated Markdown as text and generation state through streaming / streamingLabel. author accepts ChatMessageAuthor; actions replaces the default copy action; null hides actions, and blank responses have no actions. copyLabels localizes feedback. codeVariant supports block / plain; codeMessages localizes the code toolbar, and footnoteLabel / footnoteBackLabel localize footnotes; custom components own their safety. className and article attributes support layout and accessibility. Install with npx zeron-ui add chat-markdown-01, then import ChatMarkdownResponse and pass text.
chatMarkdownBlock.behaviorBody: The demo initially shows the complete answer. Replay appends local example text; Stop retains the partial response and Show all restores the full text. Scrolling up pauses following; Scroll to latest resumes it and focuses the reading area. ResizeObserver handles content and viewport changes, including delayed highlighting after completion, without scrolling a paused reader. Copy response writes the original Markdown; CodeBlock owns code copying and wrapping. Raw HTML is not executed and the parser filters unsafe URL schemes. The host supplies model calls, cancellation and persistence.
